plan.typographyTuning: Mirage previously reviewed development cards only; fresh Mirage and Tempest holdouts evaluated after renderer policy freeze.
plan.alignment: Keep original Mirage retro-seventh transform and unchanged Tempest copy. No per-scan fitting.
plan.acceptance: Same inputs, refs, fonts, metrics and browser for paired body edge F1, soft-wrap and block geometry. Measure all 700 printings, report clipping/failures and per-card regressions. Asset replacements and early-basic-land presentation changes are outside this typography pass.

reviewExamples.question: Mtenda Herder: do you agree that the italic face looks too heavy or wide? The reminder is now italic, but still takes four lines instead of the scan’s three. This is the largest development regression.
Mogg Conscripts: does the body look primarily too large, or too wide/heavy at the right height? Both versions wrap too early; the new styles are correct, but the body edge score falls.
Lead Golem: does the new version look closer overall? Its wrapping is now exact and its flavor is italic, yet the edge score falls. The remaining lettering is heavier than the scan.

note: Same before/after renderers, fonts, inputs, metrics and shared alignment transforms. Reviewed, confidently aligned holdouts only. F1 is structural similarity, not accuracy percentage. Bootstrap intervals describe the selected cards; ±0.02 F1 and 2px geometry are review thresholds, not acceptance gates.
